name: Teki wa Kaizoku Kaizoku Ban
source:
I am a first class pirate. There was a call from my noisy boss to settle one matter. While on it, two ships of my old enemy appeared. Together with my alien cat Apro I was able to settle the incident. However, strange incidents started to happen one after another. Based on the light novel series.

[From [url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/04/vn-of-year-1987.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
我是一名海盜課一級刑警。愛嘮叨的上司打來電話，要我處理一樁案件。執行任務時，宿敵的兩艘太空船突然現身。我和外星貓阿普羅聯手解決了事件，可隨後又接連發生了種種怪事。

本作改編自同名輕小說系列。

［引自[url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/04/vn-of-year-1987.html]vndbreview[/url]］
